### Do It Again, God
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/do-it-again-god
Passage: Joshua 6:2-3, 5
Points:
- Waiting silently day after day can tempt believers to grow impatient with God's timing.
- Israel secured victory not through military power, but simply by trusting God's word.
- Fortified walls and impossible obstacles can make people feel small and forgotten.
- God's supreme gift of His Son assures believers that He will bring ultimate victory.
- Remembering how God moved in the past keeps our faith secure against modern idols.

### Doing Things God’s Way
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-28-2018.html
Passage: Joshua 6:14
Points:
- God desires faithful obedience rather than human solutions or carefully crafted plans.
- Israel had to keep taking obedient steps even when the walls showed no initial change.
- Stopping short in our obedience robs us of the victory God intends to bring.
- An absence of visible progress does not mean God has ceased working.
- Believers must choose to walk daily by faith instead of depending on sight.

### What’s Your Jericho?
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/what-s-your-jericho-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-august-14-2015.html
Passage: Joshua 6:3, 15
Points:
- The seven-day procession granted Jericho's inhabitants a prolonged chance to turn and repent.
- Circling the walls forced the Israelites to realize how formidable the obstacle truly was.
- Christians face their own modern Jerichos in illnesses, family crises, and unsolvable dilemmas.
- Spiritual breakthroughs begin when we humbly admit we cannot handle matters alone.
- Walking around overwhelming barriers reminds us to depend entirely on God.

### The Fall of Jericho
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fall-of-jericho
Passage: Joshua 6:16
Points:
- Jericho's shut gates required divine power rather than human military calculations.
- Overcoming the fortress came through following the specific instructions God commanded.
- Jericho's downfall demonstrates holy judgment against persistent, unrepentant wickedness.
- Rahab’s preservation reveals that anyone who turns in faith to God will find salvation.
- Today's spiritual battles must be fought through God’s ordained means: prayer, preaching, and sacraments.
